$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the tier ladder. Consumed by get-agent-ready.astro (visible cards + JSON-LD offers) and llms.txt.ts. Change a price HERE only — never in a page. A build-time assertion in scripts/check-pricing.mjs fails the build if any surface diverges.

tiers.name: Agent Preview
tiers.blurb: See what AI can learn from your website and what may get in its way.
tiers.llms: free check of one public web page, self-serve — how an AI agent reads it, no signup, nothing stored; private Cloudflare settings remain unverified

tiers.name: Agent Ready
tiers.blurb: Your business profile on the AICV network, plus a private review of what to improve.
tiers.llms: $500 one-time — activate your Minimum Viable Agent (MVA), an agent-readable business profile, plus a private agent-readiness review; publication follows purchase-to-business matching; no annual fee, separate setup fee or Cloudflare account audit; no guarantee of outside indexing or citation

tiers.name: Agent Ready Business
tiers.blurb: Your MVA, with ongoing support and the tools that help agents find and use your business information.
tiers.llms: $1,000 setup + $2,500/yr, starts with a call — MVA, maintained discovery infrastructure, MCP routing and agent-to-agent concierge access; owner-assisted Cloudflare Search, Agent and Training review at onboarding, configuration changes separately scoped

tiers.name: Agent Ready Premium
tiers.blurb: Everything in Business, plus a deeper AI-readiness review and a 12-month action plan.
tiers.llms: $5,000 setup + $10,000/yr, starts with a call — everything in Business plus full LLM Council review (the Agentic Review), 12-month AI-readiness roadmap, public living portal and templated MCP access; no guarantee of outside indexing or citation
